properties.notes: Vacant wasteland situated at the end of an established terraced row in Ashington. The site previously occupied by a property providing retail, storage and residential accommodation, but this had been demolished earlier. In more recent years, the site had been utilised to provide car parking for the adjacent retail units but is now unused. Offers potential to provide new homes in Ashington, at an increased density reflecting the surrounds. Long identified for an urban infill scheme. A number of years ago permission was given for construction of 3 flats, but this lapsed (09/E/00357/FUL). A more recent application for a revised scheme of 5 flats has now been permitted (17/01752/FUL). Revised scheme now under-construction and forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
